paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: The influence of number of blanks to .
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of blanks and accuracy percentage for the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model. The x-axis is labeled "# Blanks," has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 6, and has tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 60 (though the exact top value is not explicitly labeled, it is implied by the tick labels), and has tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot contains a single blue line representing the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model, with a solid line style and circular markers; the line starts at approximately 70% accuracy when the number of blanks is 1, decreases sharply to around 15% at 2 blanks, continues to decline more gradually to about 5% at 4 blanks, and then levels off at around 2.5% from 5 to 6 blanks.
